info.name: Recipe Manager - QA1 API tests
info.description: Run the entire collection in order with the Local environment. Tests create unique records, use antiforgery and cookies, verify C5 CRUD and errors, then delete their own records. Runtime IDs and tokens exist only in local run variables. Use a local disposable database. Do not use --bail: cleanup must run even when an assertion fails.
